screens.name: Home — default, transition, large text, omen populated
screens.evidence: Sheets 21–22 show the gold hero, empty/populated omen and enlarged layout; supplied runtime reports responsive Home checks.
findings: Reduce the hero's vertical claim at 200% so the omen receives more visible space without weakening the orb's prominence.

screens.name: Approach — normal, transition, large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 preserves the orb and opening message across captures, with a substantially different enlarged composition.
findings: Keep the enlarged status composition more closely aligned with the centered normal state to strengthen continuity.

screens.name: Question composer — self, named person, collapsed, populated
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–03, 13 and 41 show a clear question-to-submit sequence; runtime reports retained drafts and reachable enlarged submission.
findings: Give the collapsed question a clearer editing affordance so it remains recognizably editable without a focus outline.

screens.name: Named-person selection — selected, validation and cancellation
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 and 22 show selected identity and name entry; runtime reports invalid-name rejection, cancellation and focus return.
findings: Keep Cancel changes easier to discover beneath the enlarged primary action.

screens.name: Voice entry — microphone unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 23 clearly offers typing and voice retry after failure, while successful microphone operation remains unverified.
findings: Make the permission-recovery instruction more specific to the supported browser rather than simply asking users to check permission.

screens.name: Planning — loading and cancellation
screens.evidence: Sheets 29–30 show purpose, duration expectation and cancellation; supplied runtime reports timeout, cancellation and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Provide a distinct delayed-state message near the stated one-minute boundary so prolonged waiting remains interpretable.

screens.name: Research — loading and cancellation
screens.evidence: Sheets 30–31 show research-specific supporting text within the same loading composition and reported cancellation behavior.
findings: Make the transition from checking the question to forming the forecast more perceptible than a small supporting-copy change.

screens.name: Adaptive card 1 — plan readiness
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows numbered progress and four answers; runtime reports selection acknowledgment and duplicate prevention.
findings: Align the answer scale more closely with plan readiness because 'Halfway there' can describe completion rather than certainty.

screens.name: Adaptive card 2 — obstacles
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show stable normal/transition structure and readable enlarged obstacle choices.
findings: Preserve the reported selected acknowledgment long enough for users to identify their choice before advancing.

screens.name: Adaptive card 3 — support
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show the final step explicitly changing its instruction from continuing to revealing.
findings: Make the final choice's transition into forecast generation as explicit as the preceding selected-state feedback.

screens.name: Adaptive card — custom answer, empty and draft
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows the empty disabled state and back-to-choices action; runtime reports long-draft retention and constrained-viewport submission.
findings: Separate Back to choices slightly more clearly from the step counter in the enlarged header.

screens.name: Forecast reveal — normal, transition and large text
screens.evidence: Sheets 32–33 show a prominent forecast, speculative label, reminder date and several follow-up actions.
findings: Distinguish the reminder date from the forecast horizon so an early check-in is not mistaken for the prediction's deadline.

screens.name: Check-in — unanswered
screens.evidence: Sheets 11 and 40–41 place outcome choices ahead of evidence and sharing, with the first enlarged choice reported visible.
findings: Shorten the enlarged forecast block's vertical footprint so more than the first outcome choice is visible together.

screens.name: Check-in — Yes saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 28 shows both a checked Yes row and a saved Came true acknowledgment, with persistence reported in runtime.
findings: Use the same outcome wording in the choice and saved acknowledgment to minimize interpretation.

screens.name: Check-in — Not quite saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 28 shows the selected Not quite row and adjacent saved confirmation.
findings: Keep the saved acknowledgment adjacent to the choices when the screen scrolls at enlarged text.

screens.name: Check-in — Not yet saved
screens.evidence: Sheets 28 and 40–41 show selected pending status and explicit guidance that the reminder date remains unchanged.
findings: Preserve the clear pending guidance and verify its announcement alongside the changed selection in browser assistive technology.

screens.name: Evidence overview — collapsed and expanded forecast context
screens.evidence: Sheets 13, 31 and 41–42 show four evidence destinations and a Which forecast disclosure with expanded context.
findings: Place a short forecast identifier nearer the heading so users need not reach the bottom disclosure to establish context.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Why this forecast, free and Plus
screens.evidence: Sheets 14, 18 and 32–33 show separated explanation blocks, while supplied runtime reports full-content retention and free/Plus coverage.
findings: Label the explanation blocks by role, such as supplied context, assumption and limitation, to make long reasoning easier to scan.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Your answers, original questions and legacy labels
screens.evidence: Sheets 12 and 16–17 show question-associated answers and neutral legacy Answer N labels; runtime reports preserved original metadata.
findings: Add compact answer-position cues to help users orient themselves within long enlarged responses.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Assumptions
screens.evidence: Sheets 12 and 17 show a dedicated assumptions reader with visible return navigation and enlarged text.
findings: Keep the return route readily available after long enlarged assumptions rather than relying primarily on reaching the content's end.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Current sources
screens.evidence: Sheets 14 and 18–19 separate publication, date, excerpt and external action while explicitly limiting sources to background context.
findings: Make each source's external action easier to locate after a long enlarged excerpt.

screens.name: Planning failure
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 presents a dominant retry action, question editing and an explicit no-charge statement.
findings: Preserve the current retry-first hierarchy and verify that failure feedback is announced when the view changes.

screens.name: Prediction failure
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 add Review answers to retry and question editing without obscuring the primary recovery.
findings: Keep retained answers explicit when retrying so users understand that recovery does not require restarting.

screens.name: Sensitive question — planning and prediction boundaries
screens.evidence: Sheets 33–34 prioritize support and show alternative-question recovery plus no-spend and no-memory reassurance.
findings: Explain the support destination before activation so Find support near you has a predictable result.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheets 20–21 show a restrained empty state with a direct Ask the Ball action at both text sizes.
findings: Give the empty-state Ask the Ball action slightly stronger button affordance while preserving the quiet composition.

screens.name: History — populated, multiple entries and persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheets 19–20 show dated questions, forecasts, check-in links and a persisted Came true outcome.
findings: Keep Open check-in closer to the enlarged entry's main content so the actionable destination is discovered sooner.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples and selected question
screens.evidence: Sheet 39 labels offline samples and selected Love content, while the enlarged layout shows topics extending well below the heading.
findings: Reduce the enlarged topic selector's vertical spacing so the selected question and Ask this too action are easier to reach.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 explicitly identifies offline status, offers Retry and disables creation and eligibility controls.
findings: Condense the repeated introductory explanation so the offline recovery is the clearest next action.

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 show two clear age choices and no birthday requirement at this step.
findings: Replace or explain Teen-safe defaults with a brief concrete description of what the setting changes.

screens.name: Onboarding — optional birthday
screens.evidence: Sheets 24–25 show labeled date parts, optionality and skipping, with stacked fields at enlarged text.
findings: Clarify why a year is requested when the nearby explanation only says the birthday sets the Sun sign.

screens.name: Onboarding — age blocked
screens.evidence: Sheet 25 explains the age requirement and provides a correction path rather than a misleading continuation.
findings: Match the correction action to the originating input so an age-confirmation mistake does not unexpectedly appear to require a birthday.

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday correction
screens.evidence: Sheet 26 shows correction-specific instructions and actions; supplied runtime reports retained invalid-date and eligibility checks.
findings: Reduce nonessential vertical spacing in the enlarged date form to bring Check birthday into view sooner.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected and selected
screens.evidence: Sheets 26–28 show an explicit no-focus route and a checked selection with the primary action changing to Meet the Ball.
findings: Maintain heading context when moving to the enlarged selected state, where the supplied captures begin partway through the title.

screens.name: You — profile, plan and populated memory
screens.evidence: Sheets 44–45 separate profile, plan and remembered focus, with edit and forget actions visible at normal size.
findings: Make memory management easier to discover at enlarged text, where profile actions consume most of the initial viewport.

screens.name: You — empty memory and settings
screens.evidence: Sheet 35 shows empty-memory guidance, sound/motion/text switches and privacy, plans and forgetting actions.
findings: Use a more distinct treatment for Forget everything so its destructive scope is clear before activation.

screens.name: Birthday editing
screens.evidence: Sheet 44 shows populated date parts, save/cancel and a removal disclosure; runtime reports validation and focus coverage.
findings: Use a conventional disclosure cue for Remove birthday so the plus sign does not suggest adding information.

screens.name: Birth details — initial and editing
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 and 43 show optional time/city entry, disabled saving and guidance; runtime explains saved-chart preservation during editing.
findings: Explicitly tell returning editors why they must select the city again despite having an existing saved chart.

screens.name: Birth details — live city results and selected city
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 distinguishes same-name cities by region and country, and runtime reports collapse to a selected-city summary.
findings: Retain the regional disambiguation while reducing excess enlarged result-row spacing.

screens.name: Birth details — no results
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 provides No matching city and nearby-town guidance, with saving visibly unavailable.
findings: Place the no-results message directly beside the city input so the cause remains visible in enlarged scrolled views.

screens.name: Birth details — lookup failure and retry
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows unavailable search and explicit Retry city search; runtime reports controlled failure and subsequent live recovery.
findings: Keep the failure explanation next to Retry city search rather than separated above the time field.

screens.name: Birth details — invalid time
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 places the valid range beside the invalid focused value, with runtime reporting aria-invalid, retained city and passing contrast.
findings: Preserve this field-specific correction pattern for all date and time validation.

screens.name: Birth details — saved result and successful retry result
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a separate saved result with calculated signs and Done, while runtime reports reload persistence and focus movement.
findings: Capitalize sign names consistently with the profile's Gemini Sun presentation.

screens.name: Birth details — forgotten
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 confirms time/place removal and birthday retention, although a muted 14:30 remains visible in the time field.
findings: Use an unmistakably empty time field after forgetting so the visible example cannot be mistaken for retained private data.

screens.name: Plans — yearly selected, monthly and reading packs
screens.evidence: Sheet 29 distinguishes billing terms, selected yearly pricing, packs and simulated payment mode.
findings: Keep the no-real-payments notice adjacent to the enlarged purchase action as well as in the header.

screens.name: Share — preview and options
screens.evidence: Sheets 37–39 and 42–43 show image preview, download, privacy explanation and separate invitation/reminder tools.
findings: Shorten the preview-to-download distance at enlarged text so the screen's principal action appears sooner.

screens.name: Share — preparing export
screens.evidence: Sheets 35–36 show disabled downloading and Preparing image, with runtime reporting one encode and usable secondary tools.
findings: Keep the preparation status attached to the download control and verify its announcement without moving focus.

screens.name: Share — export failure and recovery
screens.evidence: Sheet 36 shows explicit export failure and Try download again; runtime reports an actual successful PNG retry.
findings: Preserve the explicit retry label and ensure the failure remains announced after repeated attempts.

screens.name: Share — download initiated
screens.evidence: Sheets 35–36 accurately say Image download started and reiterate that private answers are excluded.
findings: Keep download-started wording rather than implying confirmed delivery to a device or another application.

screens.name: Shared-image inspection — story and enlarged preview
screens.evidence: Sheets 37 and 40 show the complete branded card and a separate Image text section beginning beneath it.
findings: Make the text alternative easier to discover without requiring users to scroll through the entire tall image first.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home and loading sheets consistently use an illustrated orb, with supplied motion checks but different enlarged-screen treatments.
findings: Reduce enlarged Home occupancy and keep the orb's interactive role explicit wherever it acts as a control.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Main-tab screens show labels and gold active indicators; runtime reports measured controls meeting 44×44.
findings: Retain text labels and verify the raised Ask orb never obscures the final scrollable content at enlarged text.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers remain consistent, but enlarged reading balances wrap into prominent two-line blocks.
findings: Reduce balance-header spacing so its enlarged form competes less with the screen's task heading.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream buttons consistently express priority, with visible disabled/loading variants and reported target-size and contrast checks.
findings: Preserve the consistent fill, generous target and explicit action wording across all primary actions.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Secondary actions vary among gold links, centered white rows and disclosure-like labels across the sheets.
findings: Assign consistent visual roles to navigation links, alternate actions and disclosures.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Cards use spacious separated rows, with selected acknowledgment and duplicate prevention described in runtime.
findings: Verify the brief selection acknowledgment remains understandable before automatic advancement.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Composer captures show labeled serif input and visible focus, supported by reported draft and focus checks.
findings: Give the unfocused input a slightly clearer editable boundary without adding a heavy card surface.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged inputs retain full text and focus outlines, with exact doubling and constrained-viewport reachability reported.
findings: Preserve true text scaling while trimming surrounding gaps rather than shrinking input text.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 35 distinguishes on/off by thumb position and gold fill, while runtime reports enlarged text and reduced-motion behavior.
findings: Confirm each switch exposes its name and state and that activating the full label row toggles it.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 21–22 show both a populated omen and an explicit no-omen state with return guidance.
findings: Give the omen sufficient enlarged viewport space to avoid appearing subordinate to decorative height alone.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 39 pairs labeled stars with a checked category and question, but enlarged topics become a lengthy vertical sequence.
findings: Use a more compact enlarged category layout that keeps selection and resulting question closer together.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: The offline Circles capture includes privacy boundaries, retry and disabled creation/eligibility controls.
findings: Remove duplicated introductory wording and foreground the currently usable Retry action.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: History entries separate date, original question, forecast and outcome with restrained rules.
findings: Keep the entry action visually associated with the forecast when enlarged text pushes it below the initial viewport.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 29 shows selected yearly status, annual total, monthly equivalent and a distinct monthly alternative.
findings: Keep annual billing and simulation status close to the selected option's continuation action at enlarged text.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Share sheets present a consistent portrait card with speculative labeling, enlargement and a separate text alternative.
findings: Increase the small preview's disclaimer legibility or surface the same disclaimer immediately outside the image.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error, city-search, voice and export states name failures and expose concrete recovery actions.
findings: Keep each notice adjacent to the affected control and verify browser live-region announcements.

components.name: Typography and spacing system
components.evidence: Serif headings and sans-serif controls form a coherent system, with exactly doubled text but substantial enlarged vertical expansion.
findings: Tune enlarged spacing independently of font scaling so headings and supporting copy do not unnecessarily separate tasks from actions.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: The sheets consistently show restrained borderless mist, with composited contrast and isolated reduced-motion/performance checks reported.
findings: Preserve the subdued treatment and continue contrast sampling across animated background positions.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Birthday forms visibly label day/month/year and supply examples, with invalid-date checks and exact scaling reported.
findings: Reduce enlarged gaps between date parts while preserving clear labels and independent focus targets.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: The confirmation and blocked screens clearly distinguish eligibility choices and recovery.
findings: Explain the practical meaning of teen-safe defaults and keep correction wording consistent with the original age input.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Focus states combine gold selection, a checkmark and a changed continuation label with an explicit skip route.
findings: Verify selected state and the changed continuation label are announced together in browser assistive technology.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Profile and saved-chart surfaces distinguish Sun, Moon and rising information and identify local saving.
findings: Standardize capitalization of sign names across profile and calculated results.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: The supplied form states cover lookup, disambiguation, invalid time, save, retry and forgetting with browser validation evidence.
findings: Move city status next to city controls and make the forgotten time visually empty.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Identity controls show selected person, editable name and privacy guidance, with validation and focus-return behavior reported.
findings: Keep cancellation readily discoverable when the enlarged identity form extends below the first viewport.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Evidence navigation uses row chevrons and expanded forecast context, while Why this forecast elsewhere uses a down-chevron.
findings: Use navigation chevrons for page changes and expansion chevrons only for inline disclosures.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Export captures distinguish preparing, failed and download-started states, supported by reported actual encoder and retry checks.
findings: Verify status changes are announced once without stealing focus from other share tools.

components.name: Close and back controls
components.evidence: Screens consistently expose close/back routes, and supplied runtime reports measured targets and several focus-return checks.
findings: Verify consistent destination and accessible naming across icon-only close, back-arrow and text-return variants.

limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime account; I did not independently execute its checks.
Screen entries group corresponding normal, enlarged and transition captures; distinct represented task states are scored separately where their behavior or recovery differs.
For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1), excluding null dimensions.
Null is used only where a dimension is genuinely inapplicable, not where interaction evidence is missing.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across every screen and meaningful component.
No hard-gate failure is established by this material: offscreen content in scrolled or enlarged captures does not itself prove clipping or an unreachable action.
Transition stills support visual comparison but do not independently establish animation continuity, timing or absence of layout shifts; those claims depend on supplied runtime evidence.
Browser target, contrast, axe, scaling, reduced-motion and performance results are reported evidence, not a complete browser screen-reader or novice-usability assessment.
Physical iPhone, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, software keyboard, microphone, haptics, payments and OS sharing remain unverified; this report does not certify native 9/10 quality.
Offline Circles and sample Sky states demonstrate honest fallback presentation, not production social, authentication or cloud availability.
Synthetic long readings and controlled failures are intentionally labeled fixtures; their wording is not treated as a production-copy defect or evidence of predictive quality.
The muted 14:30 after forgetting is visually ambiguous, but supplied runtime says stored time was cleared; this is not a finding of retained data.
topFixes: Improve enlarged layouts by trimming decorative height and nonessential spacing while preserving exact 200% text scaling.
Make forgotten birth time unmistakably empty and position city errors beside the city input and retry action.
Distinguish forecast horizon from reminder date and expose forecast context earlier in evidence navigation.
Standardize navigation, disclosure and secondary-action affordances, especially Why this forecast and Remove birthday.
Add role labels to long explanation blocks and make text alternatives and return routes easier to discover.
Verify browser assistive-technology announcements for selection, validation, saving and export statuses before treating their accessibility as demonstrated premium quality.
